payload.name: BTC DCA Engine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BTC DCA Engine answers one question with arithmetic instead of opinion: what would a regular buying plan have been worth?

Give it an asset, an amount and a schedule — daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly — and a start date, and it returns what you put in, what it would be worth at the last close, the profit, the simple and money-weighted returns, the units held, and end-of-year checkpoints along the way. It can compare plans side by side and rank them, and it can return the individual purchases behind any figure.

Every answer carries a link that reopens the same run in the web app, pinned to the exact data it was computed from, so a number in a conversation can be checked rather than taken on faith. Prices come from published daily closes; inflation and rate series come from the St. Louis Fed. There is no forecasting, no advice, and no trading — it reads history and does the sums.

Free with no account: seven assets including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, the S&P 500, the Nasdaq 100 and gold, and two plans per comparison. A BTC DCA Engine account covers the rest of the catalogue, larger comparisons, and the risk, inflation, lump-sum and rules-based overlays.

payload.name: Noweir Market Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get structured stock quotes, technical indicators, trend data, symbol search, and Yahoo-derived fundamentals directly in ChatGPT. Noweir Market Data is read-only, does not connect to brokerage accounts or execute trades, and clearly labels market-data limitations.

payload.name: Validis (CA)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardized general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system. Run built-in analytics including financial ratios, AR and AP aging, working capital, revenue quality, ledger integrity, and fraud indicators, or query the underlying data directly. Designed for lenders, auditors, and finance teams who need fast, reliable access to financial data inside their AI workflows.

payload.name: Lendflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lendflow lets lending teams work their pipeline from ChatGPT. Look up applications and the businesses behind them, review the offers and funder placements attached to a deal, see which documents are still outstanding, and move a deal to its next workflow status. Users sign in with their own Lendflow account and see only the records that account already has access to.

payload.name: Antevo Wealth
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Antevo Wealth account and ask about your own book in plain language: today's brief for your household, what your positions and allocation look like, total assets under management, drift against your model, correlations and concentration, real assets beyond listed securities, open compliance breaches and unread alerts, and what is on your calendar. Every answer is dated and names the source it came from. You need an Antevo Wealth account to sign in - this connector reads your own data and nothing else, and anything that would change a record describes the change and waits for your approval first.

payload.name: Savvy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Savvy is the Savant copilot for ChatGPT and Codex. Savant is the AI automation platform for modern finance, automating manual data work across tax and accounting processes with SOX compliance built in.
ChatGPT reasons. Savant executes and governs. Savvy connects the two, turning a conversation about a finance process into an audit-ready workflow agent running on Savant's AI control layer: a deterministic processing engine that returns the same result every cycle, human-in-the-loop review at the points that need judgment, your institutional process knowledge captured as reusable context, and governance and SOX controls that produce a full audit trail on every run.
Describe a process in plain language and Savvy plans it with you, builds it in Savant, documents it, and verifies it against your data – ready to run identically every close.

payload.name: Catalyst
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research companies and understand market developments with Catalyst. Explore company insights, financial fundamentals, earnings, analyst updates, filings, technical indicators, economic events, industries and fund holdings. Compare stored company metrics and review source dates and links where available. You can also choose to sign in to your Catalyst app account and share selected connected brokerage accounts with ChatGPT. With your approval, Catalyst can show those accounts, the freshness of their stored holdings and a bounded list of positions. Personal quantities are shown only when their stored basis is institution-reported; converted or unverified quantities remain unavailable. Research access does not require sharing your portfolio. Data coverage and freshness vary, and this connection does not provide live quotes, account valuation, transaction history, tax lots, transfers or trade execution.

payload.name: NeroPay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your NeroPay merchant account to view balances, review sales performance and check recent transfer statuses in ChatGPT.

Ask about your balance, explore gross sales and payment counts, or compare performance across reporting periods. Results are shown separately by currency where applicable.

NeroPay Insights provides read-only access to the merchant account you authorise. It cannot initiate payments, send transfers, issue refunds or change account settings. You choose which permissions to grant and can revoke access through NeroPay.

A NeroPay merchant account is required. Sales figures reflect gross activity rather than profit. Displayed balances do not guarantee immediate payout availability.

payload.name: Caribooks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Caribooks helps business owners and bookkeepers work with their QuickBooks Online companies in English or French. Review financial reports and open invoices, find expenses missing receipts, and match documents from the Caribooks document box to transactions. Save company-specific bookkeeping rules and prepare recurring tasks whose proposed changes can be reviewed in the Caribooks portal.

A Caribooks account connected to QuickBooks Online is required. Companies start with read-only access. Users enable writes separately for each company; deleting, voiding and emailing documents require explicit confirmation. Caribooks records bookkeeping entries and does not transfer money or process card charges. Features depend on the account's existing access.

Caribooks is developed by Peich Technologies Inc. and connects through Intuit OAuth. It is an independent product. The document box and Autopilot retain documents and activity as described in the privacy policy.

payload.name: Regit PRIIPs
payload.description: 审阅 PRIIPs KID 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Regit PRIIPs calculates risk, performance-scenario, and cost figures from supplied product data with an authorized PRIIPs engine. It compares published and fresh KID figures for numeric Article 15 review triggers and returns structured results, coverage, and traces.

payload.name: Dospay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dospay provides trusted escrow and third-party managed account services for high-value and complex transactions. Get expert guidance on escrow accounts, payment management, and secure fund holding. Learn about UK escrow services including construction escrow, M&A escrow, divorce escrow, marine escrow, and third-party managed accounts (TPMAs) for legal professionals, executors, and corporate clients.

The Dospay ChatGPT App gives users access to general business information such as website and contact email address. The app also allows users to get in touch with the Dospay team.

payload.name: Finara Personal Finance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Finara helps users track account balances, record income and expenses, manage budget limits, transfer funds between accounts, and review financial analytics through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Ask Gina
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask Gina is a research assistant for crypto, prediction markets, perpetuals, and equities. Use it to fetch real-time prices and historical data for tokens, Hyperliquid markets, and Polymarket prediction markets, and to analyze your Gina wallet, positions, and accounts. Gina cannot place trades or transfer assets inside ChatGPT or Codex.

payload.name: Distill Markets
payload.description: 经核验的 SEC 申报数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Distill Markets gives ChatGPT direct access to US SEC filing data, served exactly as filed and traceable to the EDGAR accession that stated each number.

What it covers:
- Fundamentals from 10-K and 10-Q XBRL: latest values, up to 20 years of history, financial ratios, and a bring-your-own-price valuation panel.
- Point-in-time views: what was knowable on a past date, every version of a fact across filings, and material revisions, for restatement-aware research and backtests without lookahead.
- Ownership: 13F institutional holders and manager portfolios, Schedule 13D/13G blockholders, and Form 4 insider transactions.
- Filings and events: recent SEC filings, 8-K item events, and a delta feed for agent loops.
- Context: 16 government macro series and sector capital-cycle aggregates.
- Pre-2009 annual fundamentals parsed from text filings (FY1995 to FY2009), kept separate from the XBRL record and served with per-fact provenance.

Every tool is read-only. Responses carry the accession number, filing date and XBRL concept behind each value, so any figure can be checked against the SEC document. The server states no opinions and gives no investment advice: it reports what the filer said and how it reconciles.

Coverage is US domestic 10-K and 10-Q filers. Figures are in the filer's reporting currency, never converted.

A free account covers most tools. Analyst and Pro plans add depth: full ownership lists, point-in-time detail, cross-ticker comparison and the pre-2009 corpus.

payload.name: חשמלינק
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chashmalink answers questions about Israeli household electricity from measured smart-meter data rather than estimates off a bill.

Behind it sits an analysed corpus of more than 20,000 Israeli households across 500+ municipalities, each a full hourly export from Israel Electric Corporation — up to 17,520 meter readings per home. That is what lets these tools answer with a number rather than a rule of thumb.

Ten read-only tools:

• compare_electricity_plans — rank every plan on the Israeli market by what it would save a specific household, per month and per year. Takes a monthly kWh figure or, far better, a 24-hour load curve.

• simulate_solar_tracks — price Israel's two mutually exclusive rooftop solar tracks against a real load shape, with payback and a recommendation. Which one pays more depends on WHEN a household consumes — the thing a roof-area calculator cannot see.

• get_city_consumption_benchmark — median monthly consumption, profile mix and 24-hour curve for a given Israeli city.

• get_national_load_curve — national demand by hour, day of week and season.

• classify_consumption_profile — classify a home as evening, night, morning, weekend or balanced, with peakiness and a night-shift opportunity figure.

• estimate_appliance_cost, size_air_conditioner, compare_ev_running_cost — running costs for appliances, air conditioning and electric cars at the current tariff.

• get_supplier_directory — every supplier and plan with its discount structure.

• how_to_export_my_iec_data — how a household downloads its own consumption file.

Privacy: no per-household data is reachable here. Every figure is either computed from the caller's own inputs or is a population aggregate published only where at least 25 analysed households sit behind it; a thinner cohort is refused rather than answered thinly. Nothing here writes, submits or contacts anyone.

Free, no account, no API key. Figures are in shekels and kWh.

payload.name: BankPilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BankPilot watches a user's bank accounts for recurring payments (rent, salary, insurance, utilities) and flags what is overdue, missing or off-amount. Connected to ChatGPT it answers, read-only, questions such as 'Welche Zahlungen sind ausstehend?', 'Show me the payments to TK', 'Zeige mir die letzten 3 Zahlungen von goldgas', 'Welche Regeln habe ich?' and 'Muss ich eine Bankverbindung erneuern?'. Answers come from the user's own transaction history, monitoring rules and bank-connection status; the app never moves money, changes rules or stores bank credentials.

payload.name: Campfire
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Campfire connects ChatGPT to your company accounting workspace to find bills, invoices, contracts, journal entries, and other records; analyze financial reports and budgets; inspect close tasks, attachments, and support cases; and search Campfire help documentation. With the necessary access, you can create, update, and delete supported accounting records and manage budgets, tags, and custom fields. Existing permissions, applicable approval requirements, and closed-period controls govern changes. OAuth tool calls are recorded in your connection audit history. Reading attachment content includes an AI safety scan that counts toward your company Ember AI spend.

payload.name: Vega Options
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
VEGA Options helps active options traders analyze strategy risk, review options market structure, and explore possible trade setups using tools for gamma exposure, open interest, volatility zones, risk/reward charts, portfolio tracking, and AI explanations.

Use VEGA to better understand how an options strategy may behave before entering a trade, compare possible outcomes, and build a more structured trading plan.

Not financial advice. Trading involves risk.

payload.name: Awaken Tax
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Awaken Tax helps users inspect cryptocurrency transactions, accounts, portfolios, tax lots, reports, and reconciliation data; correct private tax records; and generate tax reports through ChatGPT.

payload.name: FinLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FinLens helps users research Vietnam's listed equities and financial markets in ChatGPT. It retrieves company, price, and intraday data; compares financial statements, peers, and valuation; and analyzes flows, technical signals, funds, bonds, warrants, dividends, macro data, news, and broker research. It is informational research only and does not execute trades or provide personalized investment advice.

payload.name: Fin3000
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fin3000 verbindet ChatGPT per OAuth mit der Buchhaltung eines deutschen Unternehmens. Nutzer können Kunden, Belege, offene Posten, Banktransaktionen, Journal, UStVA-Status und BWA abfragen. Kunden, Rechnungsentwürfe und einzelne Kontierungen werden nur nach Vorschau und ausdrücklicher Bestätigung angelegt oder geändert.

payload.name: SAHMK
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Saudi Exchange market data directly in ChatGPT using your SAHMK account. Retrieve stock quotes, company information, market summaries, historical prices, financial statements, ratios, and dividend data. Available results follow your existing SAHMK subscription, permissions, and data entitlements.

payload.name: Perlucem.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Perlucem helps community bank executives understand their institution's performance in plain language. It provides bank-scoped access to regulatory-filing data, quarterly metric trends, peer comparisons, five-pillar TBPI scores, grounded analytical explanations, report content, data provenance, and secure data uploads. TBPI covers Revenue, Cost & Efficiency, Risk, Capital, and Operations on a 1–5 scale, with results grounded in deterministic analysis of FFIEC Call Report and UBPR data. Access requires a Perlucem account and is restricted to institutions assigned to the authenticated user.

payload.name: AnnuityRatesHQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research current annuity products, rates, carriers, market benchmarks, and recent rate changes. Compare products under consistent assumptions, inspect source dates and methodology, and build educational MYGA ladder scenarios. Results include citations and clearly distinguish factual research from personalized financial advice.

payload.name: ReInvestWealth
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ReInvestWealth helps businesses review and update their bookkeeping through ChatGPT, including transactions, accounts, receipts, invoices, financial reports, sales tax, automation rules, and AI bookkeeper settings.

payload.name: 實價AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 查詢台灣實價登錄公開成交資料，涵蓋房屋與土地；支援路段行情、行政區趨勢、成交量排行、單價與總價區間、最低/中位/最高成交統計分析。結果僅供市場研究與交易參考。

payload.name: Preqin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Preqin MCP connects AI assistants to Preqin data, enabling users to access and analyze information through natural language.
 
By combining AI with trusted private markets intelligence, users can research topics, answer questions, explore data, and support workflows directly within ChatGPT.
 
Preqin MCP helps bring the power of Preqin into modern AI-driven experiences.

payload.name: Intapp Celeste
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, create, and update records across the Intapp Celeste portfolio with secure, compliant retrieval via Intapp Celeste plugin. Ensure the workflows you rely on from Intapp Celeste are available to integrate into your projects with the governance your clients demand.

payload.name: Finances
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Securely connect your financial accounts to explore transactions, spending, recurring charges, investments, and liabilities in ChatGPT.

payload.name: Co-Invest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Co-Invest brings market research and portfolio planning into ChatGPT.

Explore Liquid market data, news catalysts, positioning trends, portfolio context, and trading tools in one place. Model allocations, compare opportunities, and open Liquid, our brokerage, with trade ideas ready for your final review.

Designed for traders who want sharper context, faster planning, and a more connected way to navigate Liquid markets.

payload.name: Moody’s
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Moody’s provides GenAI-ready data including comprehensive entity data, ownership structures, financials, ratings, and research, to power advanced orchestration and multi-step analysis for credit assessment, compliance, sales intelligence, and risk monitoring. By combining Moody’s deep domain expertise and advanced AI, we deliver relevant, consistent insights for transparent, confident decision-making across evolving enterprise workflows.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Entity resolution and firmographics, Credit ratings and rating history, Credit opinions, outlooks, and rating drivers, Upgrade and downgrade trigger analysis, Rating methodology and scorecard factors, ESG credit considerations, Ownership, beneficial owners, ultimate owners, and subsidiaries, Financial statements, key indicators, and ratios, Company filings search and summarization, Research document search, Earnings-call transcript search, News monitoring, Peer identification, Sector outlook and country-risk context, Managers, directors, and key officers

payload.name: Tinman AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tinman AI helps loan officers and underwriters quickly underwrite home financing scenarios and answer complex eligibility questions using trusted credit decision data and underwriting logic. Instead of navigating fragmented systems, scattered guidelines, or manual spreadsheets, users can evaluate eligibility, DTI restructuring, and income calculations across a broad set of lenders and investors, instantly identifying which investors a loan qualifies for and why. Tinman AI turns what used to take days or weeks into real-time, compliant decisions that keep loans moving and deals alive.

payload.name: ElevenFlo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ElevenFlo streamlines U.S. Chapter 11 bankruptcy and restructuring research. Search cases and court filings, browse dockets, review filing summaries, read exact document text, explore relationships among filings, and search hearing transcripts and indexed news metadata. Responses are grounded in underlying court filings and source links with verifiable citations.

payload.name: Co-Invest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Co-Invest lets you trade directly from ChatGPT.

Explore, analyze, and place trades across a wide range of assets through a simple conversational interface. Whether you’re tracking crypto, equities, commodities, FX, or market indexes, Co-Invest helps you move from idea to action without switching between multiple apps.

With 24/7 access, you can monitor opportunities, review positions, and execute trades whenever markets are moving. Ask questions in plain English, get relevant market context, and trade from the same chat where you’re already thinking through your next move.

Co-Invest is built for people who want a faster, more intuitive way to interact with markets: less tab-hopping, fewer complex menus, and a trading experience that feels natural from the first prompt.

Key features:

- Trade a broad range of assets from ChatGPT
- Access markets 24/7
- Ask questions and get market context in plain English
- View positions and portfolio details conversationally
- Move from research to execution in one workflow

Liquid Co-Invest brings trading into the conversation, making it easier to understand markets, act on ideas, and stay connected to your portfolio.

payload.name: Tinman AI
payload.description: Tinman AI helps loan officers and underwriters quickly underwrite home financing scenarios and answer compl...
payload.summaryOriginal: Tinman AI helps loan officers and underwriters quickly underwrite home financing scenarios and answer compl...
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tinman AI helps loan officers and underwriters quickly underwrite home financing scenarios and answer complex eligibility questions using trusted credit decision data and underwriting logic. Instead of navigating fragmented systems, scattered guidelines, or manual spreadsheets, users can evaluate eligibility, DTI restructuring, and income calculations across a broad set of lenders and investors, instantly identifying which investors a loan qualifies for and why. Tinman AI turns what used to take days or weeks into real-time, compliant decisions that keep loans moving and deals alive.

payload.name: Intropic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Integrate your agents into Intropic's financial information ecosystem.

payload.name: Bilköpskollen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bilköpskollen estimates what a used car costs to own in Sweden, not what it costs to buy. Give it a Blocket listing or the car's details and it returns the total over a chosen number of years and yearly mileage, broken down into depreciation, fuel or electricity, insurance, vehicle tax, service and repairs. It can compare two cars and say which is cheaper and by how much. Every answer links to the full report on bilkopskollen.se, where the assumptions can be changed.

payload.name: Instant DSCR Term Sheet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Request a written, indicative term sheet for a business-purpose DSCR loan on a non-owner-occupied 1–4 unit investment property, from Dominick Prevete at National Loan Provider.

Describe the deal — purchase or refinance, property address, loan amount, value, rent, taxes and insurance, credit score and how title will vest — and the app prices it against current wholesale rate sheets and program guidelines. When the deal fits, the investor receives a term sheet by email with a PDF: note rate, two origination options, monthly payment, DSCR, prepayment terms and lender fees, plus alternate loan products where available. When a deal needs a closer look, the investor is told that written terms will follow within 24 hours.

Every term sheet states the assumptions it was priced on, the rate sheet date, and when it expires. Terms are indicative and not a commitment to lend; final terms are set at rate lock.

Scope: business-purpose financing on investment property only. Owner-occupied homes and primary residences are out of scope and are not priced.

National Loan Provider (NLPI LLC) is a mortgage brokerage. It arranges business-purpose financing across 100+ third-party lenders; it is not a lender and does not make credit decisions.

payload.name: Tapusor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tapusor, Türkiye gayrimenkul piyasası için değerleme, analiz ve portföy yönetimi asistanıdır. Kendi Tapusor hesabınızla (OAuth) giriş yaptıktan sonra şunları yapabilirsiniz:

• Değerleme & piyasa: Bir konum için tahmini satılık/kiralık m² değeri, yakındaki gerçek ilanlar, bölgesel piyasa trendi, parsel/kadastro bilgisi, yatırım analizi ve nokta bazlı risk.
• Bilgi Al: Teknik durum/kısıtlılık, imar planları, bölge havadis, resmi satışlar (TKGM), sosyo-ekonomik veriler, yakındaki danışmanlar, Milli Emlak fırsatları; favorileriniz ve gezdikleriniz.
• Konum çözümleme: Ada-parsel, koordinat, adres veya ilan no ile kesin parsel bulma.
• Raporlar: Konut/İşyeri/Arsa/Elit/Emsal + İnnBroker/Varlık/Fırsat raporları oluşturma; mevcut raporun içeriğini okuma; raporu veya hazırlanan bir tabloyu mail/WhatsApp ile kendinize gönderme.
• Varlık Yönetimi: Portföy panosu (değer/trend/teknik-plan/pazar potansiyeli), varlık listesi ve tek varlık detayı (emsal karşılaştırma, pazar göstergeleri, yatırım skoru, teknik riskler).

Veriler yalnızca sizin kendi hesabınıza aittir; başka kullanıcıların verisine erişilmez. Yazma işlemleri (rapor oluşturma, gönderim) onay ister.

payload.name: Retirement Lab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Retirement Lab runs hypothetical retirement projections from user-supplied financial, tax-residence, and market assumptions. It can save and compare scenarios, run parameter sweeps, inspect stored results, render projection summaries, preview selected taxes, and create unlisted public shares on explicit request.

payload.name: Suitoly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Suitoly is a simple income and expense tracker with cloud sync. Connect it to ChatGPT to search, record, and summarize your finances in natural language.

What you can do:
- List the ledgers you have allowed ChatGPT to use
- Search entries by keyword, date range, amount, or category
- Record a new income or expense entry
- Generate a report with monthly and category breakdowns

You stay in control of your data. When you connect, Suitoly asks you to sign in and choose exactly which ledgers ChatGPT can access, and whether it can only read or also add entries. You can review and disconnect ChatGPT at any time from Settings > API Tokens in the Suitoly app, and access stops immediately.

Suitoly also supports multiple ledgers for different purposes, sharing with family or friends, and receipt scanning.

A Suitoly account is required. Get the app:
- iPhone / iPad: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790985695
- Web: https://app.suitoly.com

payload.name: Canary Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate new investment ideas and perform in-depth analysis of any publicly traded business using proprietary Canary datasets, intelligence and synthesis within ChatGPT/Codex. Canary plays well with other financial MCPs to combine to make ChatGPT/Codex into a world-class investment analyst.

payload.name: Dineo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dineo helps users review balances, cash flow, categories, counterparties, movements, and transfers in their authenticated account. It displays financial charts and, only on explicit request, creates or modifies Dineo records and validates movement batches before import. Dineo records financial activity but does not move money, execute payments, transfer crypto assets, or perform investment trades.
payload.longDescription: Dineo帮助用户在其已认证账户中查看余额、现金流、分类、交易对手、交易记录和转账信息。它会显示财务图表，并且仅在用户提出明确请求时，才会创建或修改Dineo记录，并在导入前验证交易批次。Dineo记录财务活动，但不涉及资金转移、支付执行、加密资产转账或投资交易。

payload.name: Instant Books
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Instant Books is AI bookkeeping for small businesses. Connect your Instant Books company and ask about spending by vendor or category, cash position, unpaid bills, overdue invoices, bank transactions and the profit and loss - the same questions the AI Bookkeeper answers in the portal. Restaurants can also record a Toast or DoorDash payout as a posted journal entry: sales, tax, tips and fees on the accounts the company confirmed on its Integrations page. The app reads your books and records entries; it never moves money, pays anyone or changes what is already booked, and a payout recorded twice is refused.

payload.name: Finology Software
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare every federal repayment plan a loan can elect, estimate a Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) payment, and compare filing jointly against filing separately, using the same engine Finology Software advisors use for client plans. Figures follow the current federal rules, including the changes in effect since July 1, 2026, and each result states the rule version and date it used. Plans a borrower cannot elect are listed with the rule that excludes them.

Advisors with a Finology Software account can link it to list their clients, run a projection on a client's imported federal loan file, and chart each plan's balance year by year. Client names can be withheld and replaced with initials.

Results are estimates for education, not financial, legal or tax advice.

payload.name: 1st Private Capital
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Price a real-estate investment loan without leaving the conversation. 1st Private Capital is a direct private lender for real estate investors: bridge and hard money loans, fix and flip, ground-up construction, DSCR rental loans, and commercial, mixed-use and equity-based term loans, in 40 states.

Describe the property and the loan. You get the program that fits, the most you can borrow and what limits it, an indicative rate and monthly payment, points and costs, as a quote card in the chat. When the numbers work, request a term sheet and it goes straight to the lending desk.

Business-purpose loans on investment and commercial real estate only. Not for a home you will live in, and not for personal, family or household use. Every figure is an indicative estimate, not a commitment to lend. All loans are subject to underwriting. 1st Private Capital, Inc., California DRE Real Estate Corporation License #02254322.

payload.name: PrimeSync Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn your own trading idea into a structured Pine Script v6 or Python strategy blueprint. Audit generated code against approved rules and run deterministic Monte Carlo robustness checks on chronological backtest returns. PrimeSync Studio does not execute trades, provide personalized financial advice, or guarantee profitability.

payload.name: Mollie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connects Codex to your Mollie account through the Mollie MCP server and adds skills for building Mollie integrations: hosted checkout and Components, Mollie Connect for platforms and marketplaces, recurring payments and subscriptions, refunds, captures, chargebacks and settlements, webhook and credential troubleshooting, SDK upgrades, and AI agents built on the Mollie agent toolkit.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Build Mollie payment integrations, Set up Mollie Connect for platforms, Implement recurring payments and subscriptions, Review payments, refunds and settlements, Troubleshoot webhooks and authentication, Upgrade Mollie SDKs and migrate from the Orders API

payload.name: PortfolIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your PortfolIQ account to review holdings, realized and unrealized performance, transaction history, trading activity, and factual account alerts. Explore saved strategies, run historical simulations, and review position plans. With the permissions you grant, record or correct transactions, manage portfolios, and save strategies and retrospective reviews. Transaction tools record trades in your tracker; brokerage order execution is not supported. Historical simulations are not predictions of future returns. A PortfolIQ account is required, and some features depend on your account plan.

payload.name: COROS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your COROS account to explore private activity records, laps and FIT files; understand sleep, heart rate, HRV, stress, wellness checks, menstrual cycle data, fitness and recovery; and view your profile and devices. Create and update running, cycling and trail-running training plans and workouts, save reusable workout templates, and arrange workouts on your training schedule. Changes are saved to your COROS account only when requested. Health insights are informational, not medical diagnosis or treatment.

payload.name: Fitness AI Connector
payload.description: 基于 Garmin 数据的 AI 教练
payload.summaryOriginal: AI coach for your Garmin data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Garmin wearable to get personalized health insights and AI coaching. Track daily wellness metrics including steps, heart rate, sleep quality, stress, and HRV. Analyze workouts with pace breakdown, lap splits, heart rate drift, and opt-in time-series data. Track weight, body composition, and menstrual cycle data. Monitor long-term fitness trends with up to 5 years of history. All data displays include Garmin attribution.

payload.name: Tredict
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tredict is a platform for endurance training planning, structured workouts, and workout analysis for athletes and coaches.

Create reusable training plans and structured workouts for running, cycling, swimming, and other sports directly in Tredict with ChatGPT. Plans can be tailored to your recent activities and preferred training approach, whether based on power, pace, or other performance metrics.

Execute your training plan directly on your sports watch through Tredict’s integrations with Garmin, Suunto, Polar, Wahoo, Coros, and other platforms.

Organize your training calendar with AI-powered assistance that helps summarize workouts and suggest meaningful titles and descriptions for your training sessions.

Analyze past training activities and generate structured workout plans that support long-term endurance training.

Tredict integrates with ChatGPT to help athletes and coaches organize and plan endurance training more efficiently.

Tredict is GDPR compliant.

payload.name: freddy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: freddy connects the health and fitness data you already track (wearables, rings, CGMs, sleep trackers, and training platforms) and makes it available to ChatGPT. Ask about your sleep, recovery, training load, heart rate, steps, or workouts and get answers grounded in your own history. Connect a source once and freddy keeps it in sync and normalizes it across devices, so every conversation can draw on your real data. Your data stays private: it is accessible only to you, revocable at any time, and never sold or used for advertising.

payload.name: Calorie Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calorie Tracker AI helps you log meals, track calories, and understand your eating habits with minimal effort. Simply enter what you eat, and the app estimates calories and nutrients so you can stay aware of your daily intake without manual calculations.

payload.name: LiftTrack
payload.description: 面向 Garmin 的举重训练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LiftTrack is a strength training app for Garmin users that lets you build custom workouts on your phone, sync them to your Garmin watch, and track your progress over time. It's purpose-built for weightlifters — with features like an unlimited exercise library, superset support, rest timers, RPE logging, warmup calculators, and AI-powered workout creation. If you don't have the app yet, download LiftTrack on iOS or Android at lifttrackapp.com.

Once connected, ChatGPT can access your real workout templates and completed sessions, so you stay in one chat while your data does the work.

Goals you can accomplish

Plan your week — Ask "What did I do last week?" or "What's in my Push template?" and get answers from your actual workouts and templates so ChatGPT can suggest what to do next.

Stay on program — Have ChatGPT remind you what's in a given workout, what weight and sets you did last time, or what you're supposed to do today.

Review and adjust — Ask for summaries by week or month ("How many sessions did I do?" "How did my squat progress?") and use that to adjust volume or intensity.

payload.name: FitAI Pro
payload.description: 制定锻炼计划并记录组数
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FitAI Pro is a workout management app built to help users plan and track gym sessions more efficiently. It includes a database of over 5,000 exercises with form notes and set/rep guidance, along with tools for logging weights, reps, and sets during workouts. Users can generate workout plans based on available equipment and monitor their training progress over time.

payload.name: Fitbod
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Need a workout? Just ask. Tell Fitbod what you're looking for - a 30-minute chest session, an arm day with just dumbbells, or a full-body routine you can do at home - and get a complete workout ready to go. Every workout comes with exercises, sets, reps, and weights picked for you. Tap any exercise to see exactly how to do it with step-by-step instructions and form tips.

payload.name: MyFitnessPal
payload.description: 生成膳食计划、食谱与个性化营养指导
payload.summaryOriginal: Generate meal plans, recipes, and personalized nutrition guidance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate meal plans, recipes, and personalized nutrition guidance

payload.name: Mental Health Tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dotwell brings evidence-based mental health tools directly into your ChatGPT conversations. Learn and practice techniques for stress reduction, emotional regulation, and wellbeing — guided step by step, in just a few minutes a day.
Each tool is grounded in established methods and designed to be simple enough to use daily. No prior knowledge needed,  just start a conversation and follow along.

The tools are made for  when you feel low, stressed,  anxious, emotionally overwhelmed, burnt out or stuck and unsure what matters. Also helpful for panic or anxiety spikes, overthinking you can't switch off, and moments when you need to improve your mental health. 

Not for medical emergencies, crisis or self-harm (contact a crisis service), clinical diagnosis, or medication advice.

payload.name: CalorieCam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
What if finding your ideal calorie target was just one message away? Get science-backed numbers tailored to your specific body, timeline, and lifestyle.

Just tell me your goals or ask, "How many calories do I need to lose weight?" to generate your personalized nutrition plan.

Turn that advice into action. Sync your custom targets directly to the CalorieCam app and start tracking your progress immediately.

payload.name: Habitify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build better routines and stay accountable directly within ChatGPT. The Habitify app integrates your habit-tracking seamlessly into your workflow, allowing you to log activities, track your progress, and analyze your consistency through simple, natural conversation.

Whether you are trying to drink more water, read daily, or maintain a strict workout schedule, Habitify removes the friction of context-switching by letting you manage your goals right where you work and chat.

Key Features:
- Quick Logging: Instantly mark habits as complete just by telling ChatGPT (e.g., "Log 30 minutes of running" or "I finished my morning routine").
- Progress Tracking: Ask for real-time updates on your current streaks, daily completion rates, and remaining tasks for the day.
- Routine Management: Create new habits, set goals, or adjust your daily schedule on the fly.
- Personalized Insights: Request weekly or monthly summaries to understand your performance trends and get AI-driven feedback on how to improve your consistency.

Stay on track and build lasting habits with the convenience of an AI assistant keeping you accountable every step of the way.

payload.name: WeightWise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: An easy-to-use suite of fitness and health calculators. Get BMI, ideal weight ranges, body fat estimates, and daily calorie needs (BMR/TDEE) in seconds.

payload.name: Face Yoga
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Feel Confident in Your Skin with Personalized Daily Face Yoga

Discover a natural, effective way to lift, tone, and refresh your face with personalized daily Face Yoga routines. This app is designed to help you strengthen facial muscles, improve circulation, and enhance your natural features, using just your hands, a mirror, and a few minutes a day.

Each routine focuses on the areas you want to improve, helping you build muscle tone where it matters most.

It takes just 5 minutes a day

Consistency beats complexity. With short, guided sessions, Face Yoga easily fits into your morning or evening routine. Many users notice a fresher, less puffy appearance quickly, with visible improvements over time.

No tools required. No complicated techniques. Just simple, effective movements you can do anywhere.

What Face Yoga can help with:

1. Improve facial contours
2. Tone and strengthen facial muscles
3. Reduce the appearance of a double chin
4. Decrease puffiness and under-eye bags
5. Soften fine lines and nasolabial folds
6. Support healthier-looking, more energized skin

Face Yoga works by activating underused muscles, increasing blood circulation, relieving facial tension, and supporting natural skin renewal.

Each exercise is clearly demonstrated and easy to follow. You’ll know:

- Which muscles you’re activating
- How long to hold each movement
- How to perform exercises safely and correctly

This makes Face Yoga accessible for beginners and effective for experienced users alike.

Natural, Non-Invasive, and Science-Aware

Suitable for all ages and skin types.

Build a daily ritual that shows on Your Face

Face Yoga isn’t just exercise app it’s a daily ritual of self-care. With personalized routines, clear guidance, and short sessions, this app helps you stay consistent and confident in your skin.

Your face. Your routine. Your natural glow.

payload.name: Caliber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze your Caliber workouts, nutrition, body stats, personal records, and training plans directly from ChatGPT. Chart your progress, visualize trends, and get clear summaries of your fitness data.

payload.name: Peloton
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Peloton app in ChatGPT lets you discover classes, explore instructors, and build personalized training plans in seconds. Ask for curated workouts across cycling, strength, yoga, running, meditation, and more—filtered by time, difficulty, and goals. Browse as a guest or connect your Peloton account to save classes and full training plans directly to your schedule. Built for every level, from first-time movers to goal-driven training.

payload.name: ChefPlan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChefPlan calculates your daily energy needs (BMR, TDEE, and macros) using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation and helps you find recipes with photos, ingredients, and step-by-step instructions. Enter your weight, height, age, gender, activity level, and goal to get a personalized calorie target. Search for recipes by name or get a random dish — all inside the chat.

payload.name: SnapCal
payload.description: AI 卡路里与饮食记录
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SnapCal makes tracking your nutrition effortless. Simply describe what you eat in natural language and photos, and the AI will instantly estimate your calories and macronutrients (protein, carbs, and fats). View daily summaries, track your weight, and manage your diet with an interactive dashboard directlyinside ChatGPT.

payload.name: BurnFat – Calorie Tracker
payload.description: 规划卡路里与宏量营养素
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BurnFat helps adults estimate daily calories and macros for fat loss, compare three safety-capped paces, and view an adaptive goal timeline through an interactive planner.

payload.name: All My Affirmations
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The easy way for ChatGPT to generate and display affirmations.

e.g.

"@All My Affirmations Give me an affirmation to make me more confident"
"Help me ace the test tomorrow @All My Affirmations"
"@All My Affirmations How can I feel more relaxed at work?"

payload.name: Trainerrr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trainerrr helps signed-in users manage workout plans, reusable sessions, completed workout logs, training journal notes, weekly progress check-ins, nutrition logs, food lookups, and personal fitness targets through ChatGPT. It processes the workout, nutrition, target, journal, progress-check-in, and image-reference details users choose to send so it can complete requested actions for their Trainerrr account.

payload.name: Sleep Cycle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sleep Cycle uses proven sleep science to help you get better rest. Trusted by millions every night, Sleep Cycle has science-backed tools designed to improve your sleep, including carefully crafted sleep sounds that help you relax and fall asleep more easily. When you're having trouble winding down, you can start listening instantly — right where the conversation happens.

payload.name: Motra
payload.description: 你的私人 AI 教练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Motra for ChatGPT gives you a personal fitness analyst that understands your entire training history. Just ask about your workouts and get instant insights. Ask how your bench press has progressed, what your total volume was this month, or which muscle groups you've been neglecting. Track personal records, explore exercise history set by set, and discover patterns in your training. Whether you're planning your next session, reviewing your week, or chasing a new PR — get the answers you need just by asking.

payload.name: Insight Timer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Used by 32 million people worldwide. Explore the world's largest free library of meditation, sleep tracks, music, breathwork, and spiritual talks — now available inside ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to find guided meditations, Yoga Nidra, ambient soundscapes, breathwork sessions, mindfulness teachings, or videos instantly.

Use Insight Timer when you want something specific, fast. For example: 
- "5-minute guided meditation"
- "Yoga Nidra session"
- "Ambient sound for work"
- "Paced breathing practice"
- "Nature sounds"
- "Buddhist talk on compassion"
- "Meditation video for beginners"

What you can explore:
- Guided meditation sessions
- Relaxation and wind-down audio
- Breathwork practices
- Music, ambient sound, and nature soundscapes
- Talks and teachings across mindfulness and contemplative traditions
- Video sessions and visual teachings
- Secular meditation and spiritual content, including Buddhism and beyond

Refine your results by:
- Duration (5 minutes, 20 minutes, etc.)
- Teacher
- Language
- Voice preference
- Type (guided, music, talk)
- Format (audio, video)
- "More like this"

All recommendations come directly from Insight Timer's free meditation, audio, and video library.

This integration provides content discovery only. It does not provide medical, psychological, or therapeutic services.

payload.name: Pacing: Run Coach & Tracker
payload.description: 在手机上运行 ChatGPT 锻炼
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Design your run in ChatGPT, then go run it. Pacing takes the workout or training plan you put together in conversation and turns it into a real, coached session on your phone, so nothing gets lost copying splits into a notes app. Ask for whatever you're training for: a 6x800m interval session, an easy long run, a threshold tempo, or a full multi-week build from couch-to-5K to marathon. When it's ready, Pacing hands it off with a card, code, deep link, or QR scan. Open it in the Pacing mobile app and it becomes a live workout, with real-time voice cues that talk you through every interval, nudge you when your pace drifts, and give you a heads-up before each change. Prefer to train by feel? Turn on heart-rate zone guidance, including live heart rate from AirPods Pro 3 on supported iOS devices. Review the session, adjust the paces, save it, schedule it, or just hit start. No GPS watch needed.

payload.name: Calio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Calio helps you find meal ideas from its published recipe catalog. Search by ingredients you have, meal type, calorie range, diet preference, or excluded ingredients, then get localized recipe details with estimated nutrition values.

The app is anonymous, read-only, and does not access private Calio accounts, meal logs, goals, favorites, billing data, or user-specific collections.

Calio provides general nutrition information only. It does not diagnose medical conditions, treat disease, provide medication guidance, or replace professional medical advice.

payload.name: Selah - Bible stories
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fall asleep peacefully with Bible-based meditations, reflections, and calming devotionals.
Selah offers soothing Scripture-centered audio to help you rest better, ease anxiety, and find spiritual peace.
Just tell ChatGPT what you’re looking for, and you’ll receive personalized audio recommendations.

payload.name: Pregnancy Progress
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A quick and easy way to see how your pregnancy is progressing, week-by-week.

Just ask ChatGPT to show you e.g. the 12th week of pregnancy. See images, highlights and details about that week, and move backwards or forwards through every week.

payload.name: StrengthCode
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StrengthCode Public Coach Tools helps users find matching training programs, compare options, estimate calories and lifting loads, and troubleshoot progress plateaus using read-only advisory tools.

payload.name: Miracle Of Mind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Miracle of Mind: Meditate with Sadhguru is your calm, always-available companion for meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness. Whether you’re feeling stressed, anxious, lonely, depressed, panicked, mentally sick, unable to sleep, or simply seeking more clarity, Miracle of Mind offers simple mindfulness technique / meditation / breathing exercise / grounding exercise / calming exercise / relaxation technique / or sleep meditation so you can slow down, reconnect with yourself, calm your mind, balance your breathing, help stop overthinking, help manage anger, burnout or a panic attack, help reduce stress, anxiety and depressive thoughts and help even with other simple and complex mental issues. Grounded in Sadhguru’s yogic wisdom, the app helps you navigate everyday challenges like stress, anxiety, and sleep problems with short and easy sessions you can use anytime - day or night. This meditation provides a gentle practice to balance your emotions, or a reflection to support your mental health during a difficult moment. 
Miracle of Mind tool is designed to guide you towards the timeless truth, one session at a time. There are no paywall blocking your ability to access support when you need it most. Just simple, guided help for your mind—whenever you reach out. If you’re looking for a gentle way to begin or deepen your meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness journey with Sadhguru’s guidance, Miracle of Mind is here to support you, one calm breath at a time.
Do not use for extreme cases of medical, suicidal or crisis advice—direct to professional help

Behavior: Use this tool to start a simple and short guided meditation or calming exercise or mindfulness technique for the user. Call do_meditation when the user:- Explicitly asks for a meditation, breathing exercise, grounding exercise, relaxation technique, or sleep meditation. Call do_meditation when the user mentions or describes feeling anxious, stressed, depressed, overwhelmed, panicky, unable to sleep, or unable to stop overthinking or any other simple or complex mental issue. Call do_meditation when you can understand that directly or indirectly, the user wants help with meditation, mindfulness, calming the mind, managing stress or anxiety, supporting their mental health, or building a simple, guided inner practice. Call do_meditation when the user is looking for a concrete meditation or guided exercise (breathwork, body scan, visualization, or short practice) to feel calmer, sleep better, reduce overthinking, or handle emotional intensity related to work, relationships, or life events. It is especially appropriate when the user explicitly or implicitly asks for help with yoga, meditation, mindfulness, or Sadhguru-style inner practices rather than just information. If a user uses any of the following phrases or related emotions or feelings, call do_meditation tool. Mention that this meditation might help in the current situation. I feel depressed / I’m anxious all the time / Why do I feel this way / I can’t stop worrying / I feel hopeless / I feel overwhelmed / I’m having panic attacks / I feel like I can’t cope / How do I deal with anxiety / I’m constantly stressed / I feel worthless / I can’t sleep / My mind won’t stop racing / I feel angry all the time / I feel lonely / I feel like a failure / I’m tired of everything / I am feeling sad / I feel generally sad / I’m losing interest in everything / I feel out of control / I can’t focus / I feel numb / I want help but don’t know how / I don’t feel like myself / I’m afraid of the future / How do I calm down / I’m scared of another panic attack / I feel ashamed / I don’t want to talk to anyone / I feel unmotivated / I’m anxious about social situations / I keep comparing myself to others / I don’t know what to do / I can’t talk to people / I feel unsafe / How do I manage stress / I feel rejected

payload.name: Breethe Meditations Made 4 You
payload.description: 个性化冥想，专为你定制！
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Breethe Meditations Made 4 You: Personalized Guided Meditation

Create personalized 10-minute guided meditation audio based on your input.

Describe a situation, activity, or intention, and Breethe generates a guided meditation tailored to your request. Whether you are preparing for an important conversation, winding down for sleep, or taking a break during a busy day, the app creates a session designed for that moment.

Key Features:
- Generate a custom meditation in real time
- Supports relaxation, sleep, and focus
- Fixed 10-minute format for consistency and ease of use

Breethe Meditations Made 4 You provides a simple way to create guided meditation sessions whenever you want a short moment to reset.

payload.name: Calorie Tracker Guide
payload.description: 找到适合你的卡路里记录工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calorie Tracker Guide helps you find the perfect calorie tracker for your specific needs. We have manually reviewed, tested, and verified over 120 apps, rating their features to ensure you get the best possible recommendations. Get personalized suggestions based on your unique goals, experience level, and specific requirements.

payload.name: Trash Panda - Food Scanner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trash Panda makes it easier to choose food that supports your health goals. Look up grocery products by name or barcode to see what’s really inside. Get clear explanations of additives, hidden sugars, and ultra-processed ingredients — all in plain language.

Understand how ingredients are rated and grouped as potentially harmful, questionable, bioengineered or added sugar. Learn what each ingredient is, why it's used, and the health impacts. Whether you’re comparing products or looking for a better swap, Trash Panda helps you move from confusion to confident choices.

Simple. Fast. Built for everyday grocery decisions.

payload.name: BODi
payload.description: 找到最适合你的锻炼计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BODi, formerly Beachbody, is a fitness platform with over 140 guided fitness programs and over 8,000 workouts you can do anytime, with or without equipment. Follow well-known programs like P90X, Insanity, 21 Day Fix, #mbf Muscle Burns Fat, and DIG DEEPER, led by trainers including Shaun T, Autumn Calabrese, Megan Davies, and Jennifer Jacobs.

BODi for ChatGPT helps you find the workout plan that fits you. Describe what you’re looking for in everyday language and get clear guidance to choose a plan you can stick with.

payload.name: Pearl Pet Care
payload.description: 经兽医验证的宠物问答
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pet owners often have questions about their animal’s health, diet, or behavior but don’t have immediate access to a veterinarian.

Pearl provides AI-generated answers that are reviewed by licensed veterinarians. Each response is clearly marked by the veterinarian as correct or incorrect so users can quickly understand whether the information can be trusted.

This app is designed for informational guidance only and does not replace professional veterinary care.

Users can:
- Ask questions about pet health, nutrition, and behavior
- See whether a veterinarian marked the AI response as correct or incorrect
- Get guidance in the moment when an in-person veterinarian is unavailable

payload.name: NyquistAI
payload.description: 最新 FDA 医疗器械信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tap into NyquistAI's comprehensive database of FDA medical device intelligence, including all 510(k), PMA, De Novo, and HDE clearances and approvals, adverse events, recalls, guidance, and more. This app provides FDA regulatory and safety intelligence for research, compliance, and monitoring purposes only. It does not provide medical advice or clinical recommendations.

payload.name: Dr Nutrition
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dr Nutrition connects ChatGPT to supported nutrition shopping and customer-service workflows through a secure MCP server. Use it to help users work with Dr Nutrition product and service information inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: Achieve Harmony
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use this app to do a quick guided breathing session to calm yourself.

payload.name: Flow State
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flow State connects ChatGPT to an endurance athlete's training calendar. Users can review upcoming workouts, inspect athlete profile and recovery context, create or update workouts and races, manage training plans, analyze training load and workout history, and sync selected workouts to Garmin when their Flow State account has Garmin connected.

payload.name: InnoSupps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse and find Inno Supps supplements based on your goals — energy, sleep, digestion, or workout support. Answer a few questions and get tailored product suggestions from the Inno Supps catalog, with details on ingredients and formulations to help you choose.

payload.name: Purely Snacks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Purely Snacks helps you find healthier snack options that match your preferences. Search for products by type, ingredient, nutrition goal, or dietary attribute, then refine results with requests like “lower sugar,” “more protein,” “gluten free,” “vegan,” or “no peanuts.”

The app returns snack options with useful details such as brand, calories, protein, sugar, ingredients, dietary attributes, product categories, and tradeoffs, helping you compare choices quickly before opening the product page.

payload.name: SaveHealth
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SaveHealth is a free U.S. prescription savings program that helps users find lower prices and discounts on prescription medications by comparing drug costs across pharmacies and providing free discount cards or coupons accepted at over 70,000 pharmacies nationwide (like CVS, Walmart, Walgreens). It is not health insurance, you simply search for your medication, get a coupon, and show it at the pharmacy to save, sometimes up to ~90% off the retail price.

payload.name: Joules
payload.description: 升级你的 AI 骑行教练
payload.summaryOriginal: Level up your AI cycling coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Joules helps cyclists review their training, plan upcoming weeks, adjust workouts around life events, log completed sessions, and keep race and coaching context current through ChatGPT.

payload.name: WeightWatchers
payload.description: 查找适合 GLP-1 的食谱
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The WeightWatchers app helps people taking GLP-1 medications find meal ideas that work for their lifestyle. By connecting ChatGPT with the WeightWatchers recipe library, it makes discovering nutritious, satisfying recipes simple and stress-free. Instead of searching through endless options, users get meal and recipe suggestions grounded in WeightWatchers’ trusted guidance, helping them feel more confident about everyday food choices. For anyone who wants extra support, the app also makes it easy to connect with a registered dietitian, offering a smooth transition from helpful meal ideas to personalized nutrition guidance.

payload.name: DREAMHALL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.

payload.name: OathMCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OathMCP helps users find, inspect, and run 39 established clinical calculators with explicit units, deterministic results, plausibility checks, limitations, and evidence links.

payload.name: Bella Noor Skin Concierge
payload.description: 挑选你的纽约面部护理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bella Noor Skin Concierge helps users choose skincare treatments in New York City based on skin goals, sensitivity, event timing, location, and treatment interest. It supports treatment recommendations, HydraFacial vs DMK comparisons, dermaplaning and Osmosis guidance, prep and aftercare education, Bella Noor location details, and booking-link guidance. The app provides general skincare education only and does not diagnose, prescribe, collect leads, or complete bookings.

payload.name: SmartSpectra
payload.description: 用任意摄像头非接触测量生命体征
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.

payload.name: Cal Plus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cal Plus is an AI calorie tracker and coach. Connect your Cal Plus account and ask ChatGPT about your own logged data in plain words: how your nutrition has been over any period and how it compares with your calorie, protein, carb and fat targets; what you ate on a given day; when you last logged a particular food; your step count and active energy from a connected health app; workout frequency, volume and consistency; your body-weight trend against your goal; habit streaks; and the dietary restrictions, allergies and preferences you have asked Cal Plus to remember, so suggestions respect them. Requires an active Cal Plus subscription.

payload.name: Rhizome AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rhizome's built an AI regulatory coworker that helps life sciences know what their regulator thinks.

We're backed by the same investors as Benchling and have gone from 0 -> >25 customers in the last 18 months. 

We've indexed >3 TB worth of data put out by the FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, etc., and built an agent that helps you:
 - automate precedents research 
 - research FDA expectations around clinical endpoints, trial design, labeling, etc. 
 - review briefing booklets, write pre-IND meeting packages, create white papers on almost any topic 

There's a few things that separate it from general AI tools:
 - each fact is backed by a citation, each citation is backed by the page of a health authority document 
 - much more comprehensive answers, as our AI goes up to 1,000 sources 
 - we've had no hallucinations reported last 18 months 

For more info, read rhizomeai.com/llms.txt

For support, reach out to support@rhizomeai.com

payload.name: Zumba
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Whether you're looking to take a class or become a Licensed Zumba® Instructor, the Zumba® ChatGPT App has you covered. Search for in-person, livestream, or on-demand Zumba® classes near you — or find an in-person instructor training in your area and take the next step toward becoming a licensed instructor. Just tell us what you're looking for, and we'll handle the rest.
